hero.filename: Florida Keys Scenic Highway - Over Indian Key - NARA - 7718445.jpg
hero.caption:
Scope and content:  The original finding aid described this photograph as:
Original Caption: The aerial view of 10-acre Indian Key in Florida Bay adjacent to the Florida Keys Scenic Highway reveals the foundations of buildings and cisterns dating back to the 1830s alongside a modern-day dock.
Location: Indian Key, Florida (24.889° N 80.677° W)

Status: Public domain.
